Doctoral programs
LMU Munich offers a wide range of structured doctoral programs as well as several umbrella structures. In addition, LMU cooperates with other institutions on a doctoral level.

Besides joining one of the doctoral programs listed below, LMU Munich offers the option of pursuing individual doctoral studies in more than 100 subjects.
Information on application deadlines and procedures of a doctoral program can be found on the website of the respective program. If you have any questions about a doctoral program, please contact the program directly.
